question: C1: should the introduction lead with D18's question (what the 36 series beyond HAR + RM + FOMC add) or with the every-bar full-set gain against the OLS-HAR?

solvers.answer: D18's question is the research question; then the full-set gain vs OLS-HAR with the MSE clause, the base share, and the D18 answer.
Keep the general question; lead with the every-bar full-set gain vs OLS-HAR and the MSE clause; D18's answer is contribution 2.
The research-question beat states D18's two levels; first result is the full-set gain vs OLS-HAR plus MSE; then channels, beyond base, application.

refutation.note: All three agree on the result order, and the 28 Oct approval (3c6ccc4) kept the full-set gain first, so the order survived. On the research-question sentence, leading with D18 alone (evidence) and the generic question alone (author record) were each refuted; the referee's two-level question stands.

precedence_note: D1/D2/D7 fix target, benchmark and MSE clause; D18 fixes the question. They compose by scope. The 28 Oct approval of the abstract edit is the latest act and kept the order.
final_answer: The research-question beat asks two things: (a) do the exogenous series improve every-bar forecasts against the OLS-HAR (D1, D2); (b) what do the 36 series beyond HAR, the futures' realized moments and the FOMC calendar add (D18). Three numbered contributions: the full-set gain with the D7 MSE clause; the two channels (HAR + RM + FOMC delivers 89-101% of each class's gain); beyond the base (nothing significant in the penalized linear models on every bar, -1.6% / -1.8% in LightGBM / XGBoost, sparse). Application in two sentences. Abstract order unchanged.
answer_short: The introduction asks two questions: does the full set beat OLS-HAR on every bar, and what do the 36 other series add beyond HAR, realized moments and FOMC. Results keep their order.
rationale: Wording of the research question is taste, implied by D18, the 28 Oct approval and the 25/28 Oct alternative-data quotes (adjudication: T2, 0.75).

actions.detail: Research-question bullet (l.49) becomes two-level; contributions renumbered to gain, channels, beyond base. Waits for the author's answer to Q8 (Q-2026-10-29-09); applied in whichever layer he reads first.
First bullet mirrors the order. Waits for the author's answer to Q8 (Q-2026-10-29-09); applied in whichever layer he reads first.

consequences: Introduction: research-question bullet and the three numbered contributions. Conclusion: first bullet. No number, table or generator changes; the abstract's order stays.
recommendation: Two-level research question; results in the order gain, channels, beyond base.
default: Applied provisionally; the paper edits wait for the answer to Q8.
